title: Platform App Builder
description: Declarative apps: data modeling, formulas and validation, Flow, Lightning App Builder and deploying changes.

questions.prompt: A requirement can be met with a formula field or with Apex. What should an App Builder choose?

options.text: Apex, because code is more flexible and easier to change later

questions.explanation: Prefer declarative tools when they meet the requirement: less to maintain, no tests or deployments of code.

questions.prompt: The business needs e-signatures and there's a well-reviewed managed package for it. What should you consider first?

options.text: Building it from scratch in Apex

questions.explanation: Before building, check AppExchange: existing solutions are usually faster and maintained by the vendor.

questions.prompt: Which tool shows objects and their relationships as a diagram, and can create fields?
questions.explanation: Schema Builder visualises the data model and lets you add objects, fields and relationships.

questions.prompt: Which controls whether a user can see a specific field anywhere, including reports and the API?

options.text: Page layout for the user's profile

questions.explanation: Field-level security applies everywhere; page layouts only affect what's shown on that layout.

questions.prompt: Users should see only their own Cases, but managers should see their team's. What combination?

options.text: OWD Private plus the role hierarchy
Sharing rules from each user to their manager

questions.explanation: Private OWD limits access to owners; the role hierarchy opens it up to managers above them.

questions.prompt: Why is it worth checking an edition's limits before designing an app?

options.text: Editions limit things like custom objects, fields per object and automation
Limits are the same in every edition, so there's nothing to check

questions.explanation: Editions and licences cap custom objects, fields and other features, which can shape the design.

questions.prompt: Recruiters need their own navigation bar with Positions, Candidates and Reports. What do you create?

options.text: A new profile with only those tabs visible
A Lightning app with those tabs

questions.explanation: Lightning apps group tabs, utility items and branding for a set of users.

questions.prompt: Interview records must be deleted when their Position is deleted, and Position needs a count of interviews. Which relationship?

options.text: A lookup from Interview to Position with cascade delete

questions.explanation: Master-detail gives cascade delete and roll-up summary fields on the master.

questions.prompt: Candidates can apply for many Positions and each Position has many Candidates. How do you model this?

options.text: Two lookup fields on Position pointing to Candidate records
A lookup from Candidate to Position
A junction object (Job Application) with master-detail to both

questions.explanation: Many-to-many relationships use a junction object with two master-detail relationships.

questions.prompt: Which can a roll-up summary field calculate on the master? Choose 2.

options.text: SUM of a number field on details
Average of a formula that references another object

questions.explanation: Roll-ups support COUNT, SUM, MIN and MAX over master-detail children. Lookup children need Flow or Apex.

questions.prompt: What risk comes with changing a field's type, for example text to number?

options.text: Every record on the object gets a new record Id
Existing data can be lost or truncated

questions.explanation: Some conversions lose data. Check the data and dependencies (formulas, reports, code) first.

questions.prompt: An import must match Accounts by an ERP number rather than Salesforce Id. What should the ERP number field be?

options.text: A text field marked External ID (and unique)
A picklist field holding every ERP number

questions.explanation: External ID fields can be used to upsert, matching existing records without Salesforce Ids.

questions.prompt: You must update 80,000 records from a CSV. Which tool?

options.text: Mass Update from a list view

questions.explanation: The Import Wizard handles up to 50,000 records; Data Loader handles far more and supports update and delete.

questions.prompt: Which relationship type is available only on the User object, for example a user's manager?
questions.explanation: Hierarchical relationships link a user to another user.

questions.prompt: A field must hold exactly five digits. What's the simplest rule?

options.text: A before-save flow that clears the field if it isn't five digits

questions.explanation: A validation rule with REGEX checks the format and shows an error when it doesn't match.

questions.prompt: A validation rule should block changing the Amount once Stage is Closed Won. Which functions help? Choose 2.
questions.explanation: AND(ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed Won'), ISCHANGED(Amount)) blocks the change.

questions.prompt: Which function returns a field's value before the current edit in a validation rule?
questions.explanation: PRIORVALUE returns the value before the change.

questions.prompt: A Job Application needs to show its Position's Department without storing it. What do you use?

options.text: A text field updated by hand

questions.explanation: Formulas can read parent fields through relationships, calculated when viewed.

questions.prompt: Set a field on the record being saved, as fast as possible, with no code. Which tool?

options.text: After-save record-triggered flow with an Update Records element

questions.explanation: Before-save (Fast Field Updates) flows change the triggering record with no extra DML.

questions.prompt: Discounts over 15% must be approved by the rep's manager, and the record locked meanwhile. What do you build?

options.text: A screen flow that asks the manager and locks the record

questions.explanation: Approval processes route records for sign-off and lock them while pending.

questions.prompt: Create a follow-up task 7 days after an Opportunity closes. What's best?

options.text: A scheduled path on a record-triggered flow
A daily report of closed opportunities emailed to reps

questions.explanation: Scheduled paths run actions relative to a date or the trigger time.

questions.prompt: A flow updates each contact of an account inside a Loop. What's the better design?

options.text: Keep the Update inside the loop
Collect changes in a collection variable and update once after the loop
Call a subflow per contact that updates that contact

questions.explanation: DML inside loops wastes limits; update the whole collection once.

questions.prompt: Some fields should appear only when Status is Escalated, on the record page. What do you use?

options.text: A new page layout assigned to escalated cases
Dynamic Forms with field visibility rules

questions.explanation: Dynamic Forms place fields as components with their own visibility rules.

questions.prompt: Users want a button on Account that creates a Contact with Account pre-filled. What do you create?

options.text: An object-specific Create a Record quick action on Account
A global action that creates a Contact from anywhere

questions.explanation: Object-specific create actions set the relationship to the parent automatically.

questions.prompt: Which controls the key fields shown in a record's highlights panel and in the mobile app?
questions.explanation: Compact layouts decide the fields in the highlights panel and mobile record headers.

questions.prompt: Sales and Support should see different Account record pages. How?

options.text: Assign Lightning record pages by app, record type and profile
Create a second Account object for the Support team

questions.explanation: Lightning App Builder pages can be assigned per app, record type and profile.

questions.prompt: Reps need guidance and key fields for each Opportunity stage at the top of the record. What do you configure?
questions.explanation: Path shows stages with key fields and guidance for success.

questions.prompt: You need to test a change against a realistic subset of production data, refreshed weekly. Which sandbox?
questions.explanation: Partial Copy includes sample data from a template and can refresh every 5 days.

questions.prompt: How do you move new fields and a flow from a sandbox to production without code tools?

options.text: Outbound change set from the sandbox, deployed as an inbound change set in production
Data Loader, exporting the metadata from the sandbox and importing it

questions.explanation: Change sets move metadata between connected orgs.

questions.prompt: Which is true of unmanaged packages?

options.text: They can be upgraded automatically when the publisher releases a new version
They're mainly for sharing templates; installed components are editable and can't be upgraded

questions.explanation: Unmanaged packages distribute editable components once; they don't support upgrades.

questions.prompt: A few users on the same profile need to edit one extra object. What's the most maintainable way?
questions.explanation: Permission sets grant extra permissions to individual users without multiplying profiles.

questions.prompt: Every Position in the Engineering department must be readable by the Engineering Managers group. OWD is Private. What do you create?

options.text: A criteria-based sharing rule on Department
An owner-based sharing rule from recruiters to the group

questions.explanation: Criteria-based sharing rules share records by field values, regardless of who owns them.

questions.prompt: A recruiter wants to give one colleague access to one specific Candidate record, just this once. What's the simplest option?

options.text: A sharing rule for that colleague

questions.explanation: Manual sharing grants access to a single record, when the OWD is Private or Public Read Only.

questions.prompt: The business tracks companies it sells to. Should you create a custom 'Company' object?

options.text: No: use the standard Account object, which already integrates with Contacts, Opportunities and reports
Yes, because standard objects can't have custom fields or layouts added to them

questions.explanation: Standard objects come with built-in features and relationships; reuse them before building custom ones.

questions.prompt: Where can an admin quickly see how many custom fields an object uses against its limit?

options.text: Schema Builder, which lists the field count against the limit
Object Manager, the object's Object Limits page

questions.explanation: Each object's Object Limits page shows usage against limits for fields, relationships and more.

questions.prompt: Users can't find a custom object's records in global search. What's a likely cause?

options.text: The object has no record types
The object's org-wide default is Private

questions.explanation: Custom objects need search allowed (and a tab, in some cases) to appear in global search.

questions.prompt: Which controls what records a user can see through the hierarchy, rather than what they can do?
questions.explanation: Roles drive record visibility through the hierarchy; profiles and permission sets control what users can do.

questions.prompt: Several objects need the same Region picklist values. What keeps them in sync?

options.text: Copy the values to each field
A lookup to a Region object only

questions.explanation: Global value sets share one list of values across picklist fields.

questions.prompt: When deleting a parent record, what options exist for a custom lookup field's children? Choose 2.

options.text: Always delete the children like master-detail
Move children to the Recycle Bin automatically
Clear the value of the lookup field
Don't allow deletion of the lookup record that's part of a lookup relationship

questions.explanation: Custom lookups can clear the field (default) or block the delete; cascade delete is for master-detail (and only some special cases).

questions.prompt: By default, can a detail record be moved to a different master record?

options.text: No, unless 'Allow reparenting' is enabled on the relationship
Yes, any user with edit access can always change the master

questions.explanation: Master-detail fields can't be changed after creation unless reparenting is allowed.

questions.prompt: Users should be warned, but not blocked, when creating a Contact with an existing email. What do you configure?

options.text: A matching rule and a duplicate rule set to Allow with an alert
Make Email a unique field on Contact so duplicates are flagged

questions.explanation: Duplicate rules can allow with an alert, or block; matching rules define what counts as a duplicate.

questions.prompt: Auditors want to see the old and new values of Salary changes on Position. What do you enable?

options.text: Setup Audit Trail for the Position object

questions.explanation: Field history tracking records old and new values for chosen fields.

questions.prompt: Which field type can't be used to filter in a report or list view as flexibly as text?
questions.explanation: Long and rich text areas have limited filtering; use other field types for values you filter on.

questions.prompt: A formula should return 'Low', 'Medium' or 'High' from a Priority picklist. Which function is most suitable?
questions.explanation: CASE works with picklists and returns a value for each match.

questions.prompt: Which is the correct way to test a picklist value in a formula?
questions.explanation: Picklists are tested with ISPICKVAL (or TEXT(field) = 'value').

questions.prompt: A formula should use Discount__c, or 0 when it's blank. Which function?
questions.explanation: BLANKVALUE returns a substitute when the field is blank.

questions.prompt: A validation rule should apply only when a record is created, not on edits. Which function helps?
questions.explanation: ISNEW() is true only when the record is being created.

questions.prompt: Support agents need a guided, multi-step form to log a product return. What do you build?
questions.explanation: Screen flows show screens to users and collect input step by step.

questions.prompt: When an Opportunity is Closed Won, create a project record. Which flow type and timing?

options.text: Before-save record-triggered flow with a Create Records element
Record-triggered flow, after save (Actions and Related Records)

questions.explanation: Creating other records needs an after-save record-triggered flow.

questions.prompt: An expense needs manager approval, then Finance approval if it's over $5,000. How is this modelled?

options.text: Two record types, each with its own approval routing
One approval process with two steps, the second with entry criteria for amount over 5,000

questions.explanation: Approval processes can have multiple steps, each with its own criteria and approvers.

questions.prompt: Position needs the number of open Job Applications only. What can a roll-up summary do?

options.text: COUNT with filter criteria Status = Open
Nothing, because roll-up summaries can't filter the records they count

questions.explanation: Roll-up summaries can filter which detail records are included.

questions.prompt: A flow needs the Account's open Cases to decide what to do. Which element fetches them?
questions.explanation: Get Records queries records into variables for later elements.

questions.prompt: Users want to see an Account's Job Applications directly on the Account page. Which relationship and layout element?

options.text: A formula field on Account listing the applications
A lookup or master-detail to Account, and the related list on the layout or page

questions.explanation: Related lists show child records of a relationship on the parent's page.

questions.prompt: Recruiters want quick access to notes and recent items from anywhere in their app. What do you add?

options.text: A compact layout with the notes and recent items fields
Utility bar items in the Lightning app

questions.explanation: The utility bar gives persistent access to tools like Notes and Recent Items.

questions.prompt: A Lightning component on the Account page should show only for users with a certain permission. How?

options.text: A component visibility filter based on the user's permission
A validation rule on Account checking the permission

questions.explanation: Lightning App Builder visibility filters can check record fields, user attributes, permissions and device.

questions.prompt: Users need a link on Account that opens the company's website search for that account's name. What do you create?

options.text: A queue that opens the website for each account
A custom button or link with a URL using merge fields

questions.explanation: Custom buttons and links can build URLs from record fields.

questions.prompt: Sales managers want a home page with a dashboard and their team's key list. What do you use?

options.text: A Lightning record page for the User object
A custom Lightning home page in Lightning App Builder, assigned to their profile

questions.explanation: Home pages are built in Lightning App Builder and assigned by app and profile.

questions.prompt: A change set deploy fails because a page layout references a field not in production. What fixes it?

options.text: Add the field (use 'View/Add Dependencies') to the change set
Deploy the same change set twice so the field is created first

questions.explanation: Change sets must include dependent components that don't exist in the target org.

questions.prompt: Before a sandbox can send a change set to production, what must be configured in production?

options.text: A deployment connection allowing inbound changes from that sandbox
A sharing rule giving the sandbox users access to production

questions.explanation: Production must allow inbound changes from the sandbox in Deployment Settings.

questions.prompt: What's a good practice before deploying a change set to production?

options.text: Validate it first, then deploy during a planned window and tell users
Deploy during business hours without notice so users see changes at once

questions.explanation: Validation catches errors early; planned releases and communication reduce disruption.

questions.prompt: Discount thresholds must be configurable by admins and deployed with the app between orgs. What should hold them?

options.text: A custom object with one record per threshold
Hard-coded values in a formula field

questions.explanation: Custom metadata records are metadata, so they move with change sets and packages. Records of a custom object are data and must be loaded separately in each org.

questions.prompt: Partner accounts need a different page layout and different Type picklist values from customer accounts. What do you set up?

options.text: A validation rule that blocks partner-only fields and values on customer accounts
A second Account object for partners
A permission set that changes the layout
A Partner record type, with its own page layout assignment and picklist values

questions.explanation: Record types control available picklist values and, with profiles, which page layout users see.

questions.prompt: An app must store billions of read-mostly event records for years. Which feature is designed for this?
questions.explanation: Big objects hold massive volumes with consistent performance; they're queried through their index and have limited automation.

questions.prompt: Users need to see orders stored in an ERP in real time without copying them into Salesforce. What fits?

options.text: A report on a custom object of copied orders
A nightly import into a custom object

questions.explanation: Salesforce Connect shows external data as external objects, fetched when viewed, with no copies stored.

questions.prompt: A formula must compare a picklist field Status__c to 'Closed'. Which expression works?
questions.explanation: Picklists can't be compared with = in formulas. Use ISPICKVAL, or TEXT(Status__c) = 'Closed'.

questions.prompt: Account records should show a traffic-light icon based on Rating. Which formula function displays an image?
questions.explanation: IMAGE returns an image for a formula field, often combined with CASE to choose the icon.

questions.prompt: On Opportunity, the Partner Account lookup should only allow accounts whose Type is Partner. What do you use?

options.text: A lookup filter on the field

questions.explanation: Lookup filters restrict which records can be selected in a lookup, and can be required or optional.

questions.prompt: A formula field returns the number of days until a Date field Renewal_Date__c. Which expression is right?
questions.explanation: Subtracting two Dates gives a number of days. NOW() returns a Date/Time, which can't be subtracted from a Date without conversion.

questions.prompt: A flow must take different paths for High, Medium and Low priority cases. Which element does this?

options.text: Assignment, with one variable per priority level
Decision, with an outcome for each priority

questions.explanation: Decision elements route the flow by conditions, with one outcome per path plus a default.

questions.prompt: In a flow, how do you add a record to a collection variable?

options.text: A Decision element with an outcome that adds it
An Assignment element using the Add operator

questions.explanation: Assignment sets or changes variable values; the Add operator appends to a collection.

questions.prompt: Several flows need the same steps to calculate shipping cost. How do you share them?

options.text: Copy the same elements into each flow and keep them aligned
Build an autolaunched flow and call it as a subflow
Copy the elements into each flow

questions.explanation: Subflows let flows reuse an autolaunched flow, passing input and output variables.

questions.prompt: When a case is created, the flow must create a follow-up task. Why must this run after save?

options.text: Before-save flows can't read any field values from the triggering case
The case needs an Id before a related task can be created
Before-save flows only run on update

questions.explanation: Before-save flows can only change fields on the triggering record. Creating related records needs the record saved, with an Id, so it's an after-save flow.

questions.prompt: Only opportunities over $50,000 should be eligible for a particular approval process. Where is that set?

options.text: A validation rule on Amount that blocks submission below it

questions.explanation: Entry criteria decide which records can be submitted to an approval process.

questions.prompt: Every Monday morning, overdue tasks must be reassigned to the owner's manager. What type of flow fits?
questions.explanation: Schedule-triggered flows run at a set time and frequency on a batch of records.

questions.prompt: The Escalate button on a case record page should appear only when Priority is High. What do you use?

options.text: Dynamic Actions with a visibility filter
A separate page layout per priority
A permission set for high-priority cases

questions.explanation: Dynamic Actions let you show or hide actions on Lightning record pages based on field values, device or user.

questions.prompt: Users need a navigation item for a new custom object. What do you create?

options.text: A custom object tab, added to the app
A report folder for the object
A list view on the home page

questions.explanation: Custom object tabs give an object a place in navigation; then add the tab to the app.

questions.prompt: Reps should see key fields and coaching text for each stage at the top of the opportunity. What do you configure?

options.text: A dashboard on the record page
Path, with key fields and guidance for success
A compact layout for each stage
A screen flow for each stage

questions.explanation: Path shows the stages with key fields and guidance per stage on the record page.

questions.prompt: A team wants to deliver its app as a versioned, upgradeable unit to its own orgs, from source control. What fits best?
questions.explanation: Unlocked packages are versioned and upgradeable and built from source. Unmanaged packages can't be upgraded, and change sets aren't versioned.

questions.prompt: An admin team wants to track changes in source control and promote them through environments without the command line. What can they use?
questions.explanation: DevOps Center manages work items, source control and pipeline promotion with a point-and-click interface.

questions.prompt: What does validating a change set in production do?

options.text: Deploys the changes and runs no tests
Copies production metadata back into the sandbox
Runs the deployment and tests without saving the changes, so you can deploy later quickly
Deletes components that aren't in the change set

questions.explanation: Validation checks the deployment and runs tests without committing; a validated change set can then be quick-deployed.
